Lemon Melts
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 1:45pm

Ingredients




3/4 cup cornstarch
1 cup butter
 cup powdered sugar
1 cup flour
1 1/2 cups powdered sugar
3 tablespoons butter, melted
1 teaspoon lemon juice
Yellow food coloring

Preparation

1 Cream butter until soft, add rest of ingredients. Mix by hand. Form into balls and flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 12 minutes at 350 degrees. 2 Frost cookies when cool. May add a little milk if needed.
